rapport_notes: Joanna is warm, patient, and reassuring throughout; she listens carefully and validates concerns, especially around the high-value TV and paintings.
process_discipline_notes: Rep did not hold silence after asking if the estimate and pricing made sense; she continued talking immediately after Anthony's 'Yes, it all makes sense.'

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep launches into logistics probing ('So all we have to do now is just, of course, check the items you're moving') without a time-boxed frame or promise of an accurate quote in return.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep jumps directly to confirming the move date and itemizing furniture.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep digs twice on the TV and paintings concern: 'How many of those do we have?' and 'I understand that this is very important it cost more than, of course, just the TV alone as you have mentioned it about $3,000 a while ago. Now in terms of our pricing...' Also probed the garage storage duration: 'If you're just, are you storing it in the garage for quite some time or just a few?'
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Covered in Stage 2 as part of the takeaway pitch: 'For every move, we include up to $2,000 coverage for any repair replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.' Direct answer to customer's stated concern (TV, paintings).
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Covered in Stage 2: 'Rest assured Anthony, we don't take bill, you can track your workers our guys are the most of Ved movers in the industry and we'll send you their names ahead of time to let you know who's coming to help out with the move.'
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Covered in Stage 2: 'if we run late on the time we schedule. We provide discounts by the end of the day.'
evidence_quotes.communication: Covered in Stage 2: 'Rest assured Anthony, we don't take bill, you can track your workers' (implied tracking/updates).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor with personalization: 'Typically a two bedroom apartment usually takes three and a half to five and a half hours to complete. So packing usually takes the same amount of time... I'll just quote your move more on the six to seven hour mark for the moving and then for the packing portion... three to five hours. Again, this estimate may still change, depend pending on how much packing left there is and of course the traffic on the day as well.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: 'You only pay for how long it takes after the two and a half hour minimum is meant, so the shorter it will be the lower the cost.' Also: 'This estimate may still change, depending on how much packing left there is.'
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: 'Once we hit the minimum mark, we only charge in every fifteen minutes until the move is complete.'
evidence_quotes.does_that_feel_fair_then_silence: Rep asked 'Does that make sense?' and Anthony responded, but rep did not ask 'Does that feel fair?' No silence held after open-ended questions.
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Rep did not ask an explicit closing question like 'Would you like our help with your move?' Instead, she offered to send an email and to follow up later, leaving the close open-ended.

top_strength: Joanna expertly probed the customer's two high-value concerns (TV and paintings) with genuine follow-up depth, demonstrating care and building trust, then wove both the damage coverage and 'Meet Your Mover' differentiators directly into her response to those concerns.
coaching_note: Front-load the call with a clear quid pro quo (time-boxed frame + promise of accurate quote) and ask the customer's agenda before any logistics probing; also close with an explicit rate-lock statement and a direct ask to book, rather than deferring to email review without a firm next step.
